news.title: Nous Research确认估值达15亿美元，为企业用户推出AI agents
news.snippet: 本轮融资由Robot Ventures领投，Nous Research估值升至15亿美元，并发布面向企业用户的AI agents。
news.raw_snippet:
The round was led by Robot Ventures, with participation from other backers including Nvidia, Union Square Ventures, Menlo Ventures, Samsung, and 1789 Capital, where Donald Trump Jr. is a partner. The new financing brings the three-year-old startup’s total funding to $158 million.

Popular among developers and individuals, the open-source Hermes agent has been cloned more than 24 million times, driving roughly 2.5% of global AI token usage, according to the startup’s estimates. [...] The capital will fund Nous Research’s push into the enterprise sector with “Hermes for Businesses,” allowing companies to deploy customized AI agents that can handle multi-step workflows while keeping their data private and secure.

Nous was at roughly $36 million in annualized revenue by mid-September 2026 and expects to pass $100 million before the end of 2026, The WSJ reported. [...] Nous Research, the startup developing the open-source Hermes agent, has raised a $90 million Series B at a $1.5 billion valuation, The Wall Street Journal reported on Wednesday, confirming TechCrunch’s earlier reporting.
